04/01/2025
Claim received for a low-speed collision in a parking lot involving the insured vehicle and a second vehicle. The
claimant is represented by counsel, so all further contact goes through the attorney's office.
06/13/2025
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver is naemd on it and coverage was in force at the time of the loss.
Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
08/03/2025
Obtained statements from the other driver and two witnesses, and all of them describe the collision the same way.
Photos taken at the scene are consistent with that description.
08/19/2025
Vehicle damage was inspected and matches the reported impact pattern. No earlier damage to the vehicle has come
up in prior claims or in the inspection.
08/27/2025
The claimant reports a knee injury from the collision. Records show no previous injury to the same area, though it is
not yet clear whree the claimant was seated in the vehicle, and the medical link to this crash is still under review.
09/05/2025
Medical records show treatment that followed a typical course and eased off as the claimant improved. The claimant
has given the same account of events in every conversation so far.
10/06/2025
Current status: liability is clear on the facts gathered, while the injury causation question remains open pending the
treating provider's written opinion. Next step is to send the medical file to the reviewer and continue correspondence
through counsel.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
